# forms-as-code automation help

forms-as-code is a static browser application for filling, validating, saving, and printing versioned forms.
The application discovers trusted HTML templates from the catalogs configured by the deployment.
Form data and uploaded files are processed locally by browser JavaScript and are not uploaded by this workflow.
Information supplied to an external AI service remains subject to that service's data-handling policy.

## Discover capabilities

Read ./agent.json for a machine-readable summary of supported actions and limits.
Read ./automation.html for the human-readable automation and bulk forms guide.

## Open a form

Use ?template=DA4856 to open the sole trusted version of an exact form code.
Form-code matching ignores case, spaces, and hyphens, but it is not fuzzy title search.
Use ?template=DA4856&version=2023-03.2 to require an exact version.
If multiple versions match and version is omitted, the application reports an ambiguity instead of guessing.

## Download a bulk CSV template

Use ?template=DA4856&version=2023-03.2&action=bulk-csv to render the trusted template and download its bulk CSV contract.
The browser must execute JavaScript for this action.
Plain curl or Python HTTP requests only retrieve static files and cannot execute application actions.

The downloaded CSV uses row 1 for stable machine-readable binding paths.
Do not rename, remove, duplicate, or add columns in row 1.
Row 2 contains concise human-readable labels and is ignored on import.
Row 3 contains example values and is ignored on import while its marker remains present.
Add completed records as subsequent rows.
Use only facts provided by the user, and do not invent signatures, acknowledgments, incidents, ratings, or dates.

## Render and print completed records

Open the same template in a JavaScript-capable browser.
Use Print CSV and select the completed CSV.
The application validates the records, renders them with the trusted template, and opens the normal browser print dialog.
Choose Save as PDF to create a combined PDF.
File selection cannot be initiated by a URL because browsers prohibit websites from silently reading local files.

Batches over 1,000 records require confirmation because they may consume substantial browser memory.
A generated ZIP is limited to 65,535 submissions.

## Automation state

The document element exposes data-app-state with loading, rendering, downloading, ready, or error.
Errors and completion messages are also exposed through live status outputs.

## Deferred capabilities

This static deployment does not expose HTTP upload, validation, conversion, ZIP, or PDF-rendering endpoints.
It does not support action=describe.
It does not digitally sign completed records.
